Message:
Well, this is quite the surprise!
To think there would be
someone out there able to see me...

Actually, I think
I’ve heard of this before.

Of a staff descended from Heaven
that can change bonds into power...
So, you must be able to see me
because you have that staff!

The current me is nothing but
a vestige of my old self’s emotions
left in this flower.

Little remains of my power as
the “Witch of Murder” either,
so...I’m like a ghost of sorts.

I’m also sure all the guilt
weighing on me is what’s
making the flower wither, too.
That’s why, I’d like to ask you...

Would you do me a favor
and kill me?
